origins.note: Rewritten and renamed backend-builder: kept the copy-the-existing-pattern discipline, inward references, result-not-exception refusals, injected time, the definition of done and the hand-off to commit-gate. Replaced the hand-written vertical-slice recipes with the scaffold skills (new-module, new-transition, new-permission, new-lookup, new-endpoint) and docs/recipes in the approved feature spec's Skill plan order, module.rules.yaml, the TransitionCatalog engine, Outcome/OutcomeResults, PublicIds and the Hand-edit log. Dropped role-based authorization, the single shared Program.cs registration, the source-product services and their API-key and certificate-bypass styles, and the frontend recipes (screen-builder and new-screen own the frontend).

Rewritten in part into test-writer: the source agent's default test seam (pure use-case tests with hand-written fakes, faked time, no database) became the unit-test step; the rest of test-writer (TransitionFixture walks, contract, architecture and throwaway-SQL integration tests, Vitest specs) is new starter content.
